many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    S=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]!=0]
    fives=[(i,j) for i,j in S if I[i][j]==5]
    R=[row[:] for row in I]
    # anchor 5 = one whose neighborhood touches the shape; other 5 = target; d = target-anchor

    anchor=None
    for a in fives:
        touch=any((a[0]+di,a[1]+dj)!=(a[0],a[1]) and (abs(a[0]-p[0])+abs(a[1]-p[1])==1) for p in S if p!=a and I[p[0]][p[1]]!=5)
        if touch: anchor=a
    if anchor is None: return R
    t=[f2 for f2 in fives if f2!=anchor][0]
    d=(t[0]-anchor[0],t[1]-anchor[1])
    pat=[(i,j,I[i][j]) for i,j in S if I[i][j]!=5]
    for i,j,v in pat: R[i+d[0]][j+d[1]]=v
